Edges: solid A-B along top line (through M); dashed M-C (vertical, right angle mark at M between MA-side and MB-side, i.e. the square mark at M opening down-right toward C, side ~14px); solid C-E (vertical); solid E-F (horizontal bottom); solid F-D (vertical right); solid diagonal A-C extending to C (CV shows it reaches C); solid diagonal B-D (seg_05 from B(446,65) to D(351,160)). Keep labels A, B, C, D, E, F, M placed outside their points (M above the top line). Render with a scale so the figure fits about 516x396 proportions. Note: check whether the dashed line is M-C and the solid line is C-E; both share C.

Dashed perpendicular M-C drops from M to C (dashed from M to C only). Solid vertical C-E (x=162, 160 to 349). Solid bottom E-F (y=349). Solid vertical F-D (x=351, 349 to 160). Right diagonal D-B (solid) from D(351,160) up to B(446,65). Right-angle square at M, between rays M->B (east) and M->C (south). Printed letters match CV bindings; no binding changes.
